200.description: Logged in (sets the `ferrite_session` cookie), or a TOTP code is needed

400.description: `bad-request`: the request used a bearer token

200.description: Changed; every session of the user is deleted. A session request gets a new `ferrite_session` cookie and its `X-CSRF-Token` in `csrf_token` (as the login response); a bearer request gets `csrf_token: null`

422.description: `validation`: the new password breaks the policy
`validation`: bad or expired enrollment, wrong code

parameters.name: q
parameters.description:
Full-text search over title and body. Not combinable with `author`, `term` or
`parent` (`422`); results come by relevance and `order` is ignored.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page of the same query.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: `true`: delete a trashed item for good instead of trashing.

204.description: Deleted for good (`force=true`, trashed items only)

422.description: `validation`: not trashed (`force`), already trashed, or has children

200.description: Restored from trash as a draft (`ETag`)
Title, excerpt, body and fields restored (meta is not; `ETag`)

422.description: `validation`: `at` not in the future, or illegal transition

200.description: Back to draft (from published, scheduled or private; `ETag`)

ContentDto.description: A content item with its terms and public path (`GET`, and every write's result).

terms.description: Term ids in their stored order.

version.description: What `ETag` carries and `If-Match` must send back.

ContentInput.description: `POST /content/{type}`: a new draft authored by the caller.

body.description: The block tree; an empty document when absent.

excerpt.description: Derived from the body (160 characters) when absent.

slug.description: Generated from the title when absent; a taken slug gets `-2`, `-3`, ….

terms.description: Term ids, in order; duplicates are ignored.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

ContentPatch.description:
`PATCH /content/{type}/{id}`: every member is optional and an absent one keeps the
stored value. `null` is accepted only by `parent_id` (move to the top level) and
`excerpt` (derive it from the body again); elsewhere, `slug` included, it is
`400 malformed-json`.

terms.description: Replaces the item's terms; `[]` removes them all.

ContentSummaryDto.description: A list entry: the item's columns without `body`.

FieldError.description:
One entry of `errors`: what is wrong with one input (`field` = the JSON path or
parameter name, when known).

oneOf.description: Logged in; the session cookie is set.

The account uses TOTP: send a code with `challenge` to `POST /auth/login/totp`
within 5 minutes.

LoginResponse.description: The result of a correct password (`status` tells which).

MeDto.description: The authenticated user and what the request's credential allows.

capabilities.description: Capabilities granted by the role and the credential's scopes (07 §1 names).

csrf_token.description: The `X-CSRF-Token` for this session's unsafe requests; `null` for a bearer token.

must_reset.description:
Only `GET /auth/me`, `POST /auth/logout` and `POST /auth/password` are open until
the password is changed.

scopes.description: The credential's scopes (a session holds every scope).

MetaDto.description: The API version and the site it serves.

version.description: The FerriteCMS version serving the request.

csrf_token.description:
The new session's `X-CSRF-Token` (its cookie is set with this response); `null`
for a bearer request, which gets no session.

ProblemDocument.description: The body of a problem response (the OpenAPI schema `ProblemDocument`).

RevisionDto.description: One revision: the saved title, excerpt, body and fields.

RevisionList.description: `GET /content/{type}/{id}/revisions`: newest first, at most 50 (all that are kept).

next_cursor.description: Always `null`: one page holds every kept revision.

RevisionSummaryDto.description: A revision in a list: who saved it and when, without the content.

note.description: `restored from <revision id>` for a restore; else `null`.

at.description: When to publish; must lie in the future.

password.description:
The account's current password: a stolen session alone cannot enroll another
authenticator.

TotpSetupDto.description:
A started TOTP enrollment: show the URL (as a QR code) or the secret, then confirm a
code with `enrollment` within 10 minutes.
